chip.description: V30 core (uPD70216) with an integrated timer/counter unit, DMA control unit, interrupt control unit and serial control unit.
chip.notes: Device table in src/devices/cpu/v5x.cpp (MAME 0.288): "V50 (uPD70216) -- V30 (uPD70116)". Peripherals: TCU (uPD71054/i8254 subset), DMAU (uPD71071 equivalent), ICU (uPD71059/i8259 equivalent), SCU (uPD71051/i8251 subset).
